content: Supabase provides a full PostgreSQL database, private storage with RLS/authenticated download or signed URLs, and pg_cron-backed scheduled SQL or HTTP jobs with recorded run status. Phone auth supports SMS and WhatsApp, with WhatsApp currently limited to Twilio and Twilio Verify providers. Database backups do not include Storage objects. Sources: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/overview https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage/buckets/fundamentals https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/phone-login https://supabase.com/docs/guides/cron .
